grants.title: Implications of tolerance to incoherence and receptivity to pseudoprofundity in the acceptance of misinformation
grants.titleOriginal: Implicaciones de la tolerancia a la incoherencia y la receptividad a la pseudoprofundidad en la aceptación de desinformación
grants.funder: Universidad de Lima · Concurso de Investigación Científica 2026 (CIC2026)
grants.host: Universidad de Lima · Instituto de Investigación Científica (IDIC)
grants.summary: Bi-national project (Peru & Spain) examining whether tolerance for epistemic incoherence and receptivity to pseudoprofundity predict the acceptance of political and scientific misinformation. Study 1 combines NLP analysis of decades of parliamentary records with population-representative cross-sectional surveys (N≈1,000 per country) to estimate prevalence and predictors, and to validate a Spanish-language psychometric measure of incoherence tolerance. Study 2 is a 3×1 between-groups experiment manipulating exposure to relativist vs truth-committed political discourse and measuring downstream acceptance of incoherence, pseudoprofundity, and misinformation.
